title: VeloraOS 1.10.45 - Secondary User Memory Opt-In Hotfix
releaseNotes: Fixes explicit remember requests not saving for secondary users whose Global Memory had not yet been enabled.
An explicit remember request now opts that account into Global Memory and saves the requested information immediately.
Passive automatic memory learning remains disabled until the user has explicitly opted in.
Memory remains strictly per-user and existing account settings are preserved.
